name: fld_sum_quadratic_residues_one_mod_four
statement: (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h : p % 4 = 1) : ∑ a ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).image (fun x => x ^ 2 % p), a = p * (p - 1) / 4
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h : p % 4 = 1), ∑ a ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).image (fun x => x ^ 2 % p), a = p * (p - 1) / 4
informal: For a prime p ≡ 1 (mod 4) the sum of the quadratic residues in [1, p-1] equals p(p-1)/4 — -1 is a residue, so r ↦ p - r is a fixed-point-free involution on the (p-1)/2 residues, pairing them into (p-1)/4 pairs each of sum p.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p % 4 = 1 → ∑ a ∈ Finset.image (fun x => x ^ 2 % p) (Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)), a = p * (p - 1) / 4
